scope: All 209 Phase 2 weapon source claims, Core through Threats of the Galaxy. Authority/schema normalization only; no production mutation.
principles: Ammunition type and shot capacity are sourced from weapon descriptions and explicit ammo/payload blocks, not inferred from table silence or current repo defaults.
Pure melee weapons use ammo:null. A hybrid identity can have ammo only for an explicit ranged firing profile.
capacityShots is canonical full loaded/pack capacity, never mutable current remaining shots.
Delivery-system weapons own attack mechanics; loaded ammunition owns payload damage/effects unless the source explicitly makes the launcher modify them.
Do not infer an ammo type/capacity when a source claim does not state one; represent not-stated explicitly.
Keep canonicalStats.resource/resourceProfiles during the v2.9 authority normalization so powered-melee and non-ammunition operating resources are not lost.

canonicalStatsAmmoContract.applicability: null for pure melee/non-ammo identities; structured object for ranged firing systems, ranged self-contained projectiles, or hybrids with explicit ranged ammo use
canonicalStatsAmmoContract.capacityRule: capacityShots is the maximum shots/rounds/charges held by the published pack/cell/magazine/cartridge/launcher when explicitly stated. Current remaining shots are runtime state.
canonicalStatsAmmoContract.payloadRule: When payloadDerived=true, select loaded ammo/payload authority first; resolve launcher attack mechanics second; resolve payload damage/type/stun/area/effects from the loaded ammo; then apply launcher-specific transforms.

payloadProfileExtension.reason: Payload-owned xN damage such as Threats Light Concussion Missile 4d10x2 must remain on the payload rather than be flattened into launcher base damage.

bookPhases.book: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide

implementationGuardrails: Do not mutate packs/weapons.db in this normalization pass.
Do not rewrite certified base damage, stun, range, qualities, availability, or source provenance while adding ammo.
Do not invent generic blaster power packs/energy cells where the current source claim does not state them.
Do not convert a grenade/missile/rocket payload into intrinsic launcher damage.
Do not delete canonicalStats.resource or resourceProfiles until runtime migration has an explicit replacement for powered-melee and non-ammo resources.
Preserve cross-publication source claims separately until identity precedence/reconciliation is complete.
